## Setup needed here
1. Pick any endpoint that can receive a POST with a JSON body - a webhook.site URL (for quick testing), a Slack/Discord incoming webhook, or your own server.
2. Import + Activate this workflow.
3. Open "HTTP Request - Send Error" and replace the placeholder URL with that endpoint.
4. Go to each of your other workflows (it-support-tools, post-call-review) -> ⋮ menu -> Settings -> Error Workflow -> select "IT Support - Error Notifications".
5. Now a failed tool call or review generation POSTs {timestamp, workflow, node, error, execution_url} to that URL instead of failing silently.
